findings.text: follow-on: _plan_comment_store_path now raises the unrelated-edit refusal, but it is invoked after _record_landing_comment, so in the not-already-recorded branch a fresh comment write may already have touched the plan before the refusal; the refusal is fail-closed and commits nothing, yet a plan carrying both an unrelated edit and a just-recorded comment is left with the comment uncommitted beside the edit rather than rolled back. Reachable only when a comment must be recorded and an unrelated edit coexists; recoverable by committing or discarding the edit and re-promoting.

follow-on: the node's orientation write paths named an evidence fragment and a figure directory for this node, and neither exists at head (the reviewed commit's changed paths are the two source files only), whereas the sibling §10 node complete-refuses-an-open-revert produced its fragment; deliver the declared fragment/figure or record an explicit waiver.

justifications.durability: the guard is genuine rather than merely tested: I showed it fires by removing the shared comparison (base source, new module) and the unrelated-edit case fails DID NOT RAISE CrewError while the carries case still passes, so the test discriminates the fix. The helper fails closed on every unreadable condition (missing id, path outside checkout, absent HEAD blob, unreadable plan, unrendered state), the two new cases synthesise a per-case repository and RECKON_HOME and assert the real plan and crew directories are untouched, and no fixture derives from its own line number or date. The residual is a reachability nuance: the raise sits after _record_landing_comment, so in the not-already-recorded branch a plan that both carries an unrelated edit and needs a fresh comment is left with that comment uncommitted beside the edit; recoverable, but the refusal does not roll the comment back.
justifications.evidence: the run's own armed arms are readable and both green: baseline_suite c8087d0b over tests/test_repromotion_commits_its_recorded_comment.py + tests/test_crew_promotion.py records 52 passed EXIT=0, after_suite 4e2c05ce7 over those plus the new module records 54 passed EXIT=0, so the added-failure delta is 0 with no ids. I independently reproduced the named gate from a /tmp extraction of the reviewed head (module.__file__ printed as .../head/reckon/crew/promotion.py, hasattr True): 2 passed EXIT=0; and I falsified the guard by dropping base promotion.py into the head tree with the new module present, which reddens the refusal case (1 failed DID NOT RAISE CrewError / 1 passed, EXIT=1). The -3: the node declared an evidence fragment and a figure directory in its orientation write paths and delivered neither (changed_paths is a two-file source diff), and the head-arm log header names `python -m pytest` where the manifest names the venv interpreter.
justifications.fit: the helper composes the file's existing idioms verbatim (the _git probe, _path_differs_from_head, and _plan_html.read_state/write_state used by the store) and sits beside _plan_comment_store_path where the decision belongs; the two new tests follow the module's per-case repository/RECKON_HOME fixture and helper pattern; the commit subject and body are conventional, bodied and carry no plan, ticket or AI attribution. The -2 is that the helper rebuilds and re-renders the whole plan on every already-recorded re-promotion purely to decide inclusion, and its docstring's 'unrelated change anywhere' claim is only as strong as write_state's byte-stability on plans whose HEAD text was not itself written by write_state.
justifications.goal_fidelity: the reported defect reproduces and is closed: at base c8087d0b a re-promotion whose landing comment already sits on disk returned the whole plan file whenever it differed from HEAD, so an unrelated uncommitted edit was swept into the landing commit; at head 4e2c05ce _plan_comment_store_path carries the file only when _working_copy_differs_only_by_its_comment rebuilds HEAD's plan plus this run's one comment and the two version stamps and matches the disk byte for byte, otherwise it raises CrewError naming the plan file before _commit_landing_writes runs. The -1 is that the helper can only ever carry the comment, so any landing whose plan legitimately differs by more than the comment now refuses as if the change were unrelated, a deliberate narrowing a coordinator must repair by hand.
justifications.scope_discipline: the diff is exactly reckon/crew/promotion.py (+102/-12) and the new tests/test_landing_commit_carries_only_its_own_comment.py (+213), both inside the declared fence, with no unrelated edit, no stray directory and no plan/sprint/ticket identifier in source; the -1 is that the declared evidence fragment and figure directory were not produced, a delivery shortfall rather than scope creep.
